configuration.document_representation: title + text, one passage per document

limitations: Document retrieval only. BM25 is an independent lexical reference, not Folio's current retriever. Azure mode uses Folio embeddings and Qdrant, with one passage per document and no production score threshold. Neither mode evaluates generation, ingestion/chunking, permission correctness, or prompt-injection robustness. API token usage/cost is not measured; failures abort rather than omitting queries.
latency_scope: Ranking only with precomputed Azure query vectors. The isolated public corpus is fully authorized, so raw ranking omits always-true policy/scope predicates; five queries are compared with production filtered search. Embedding wall time is separate. Not production filtered or end-to-end API latency.
